evaluation: Same exact trial IDs, labels, artifact flags and held-out subject folds as the prior 9-channel benchmark. Train/validation/test people are disjoint. Previously inspected public benchmark: repeated development evaluation, not a new blind test.
comparison: Previous 9-channel baseline plus 9/22-channel logarithmic covariance features with shrinkage LDA, RBF SVM(C=1), ExtraTrees(300 trees,min_samples_leaf=5), and MLP(64,16). Nine-channel controls distinguish feature/algorithm changes from extra electrodes.
features: Each epoch independently: common average reference, causal order-4 Butterworth, discard first 0.5s, covariance/trace, fixed 5% diagonal shrinkage, matrix logarithm, weighted symmetric vectorization. No target batch normalization or label-based feature selection.

neural.sample_weight: equal total weight per source training person

selection: All scalers and model weights fit training data only. Select family/channel count/checkpoint solely by validation subject-macro balanced accuracy; ties keep earlier candidate. Majority vote combines validation-selected linear/SVM, tree, and neural models. Final winner among baseline, 8 new models and majority vote selected before any outer-test predictions.
deployment: Save validation-selected model and validation-selected neural model for every fold. Demo uses fixed fold 0, never highest test-scoring fold. Labels 0=left,1=right. No calibrated confidence output.
